action: linear scale calibration of player_dpm_calc to real DARKO scale

calibration.method: OLS of real DARKO (y) on formula DPM (x), fit on 2026 overlap via br_player_id

notes: correlation is UNCHANGED by design (linear transform); only scale/offset aligned to real DARKO
calibrated std (1.260) < real std (1.603) is expected OLS regression-to-mean: std_pred = r * std_real = 0.7951 * 1.603 = 1.274
coefficients fit ONLY on 2026 (the one season with real DARKO); applied uniformly to 1974-2025 as approximation
source column remains 'formula' -- DO NOT present these as official DARKO values
